name: digg-web-build
description: Build-time helper for digg's browser UI. digg itself is a Go program (see src/); this exists only so `bun run build:web` works from the repo root. The built page is committed to src/internal/server/webdist, so a clean checkout builds with the Go toolchain alone.

scripts.build:web: cd web && bun install && bun run build
scripts.typecheck:web: cd web && bun install && bun run typecheck
